# A program's own package wrapped by `sngl tool cgogen` sits beside the
# platform's wrapper package: both Go packages are named `cgo`, so the
# program imports the second under another name, and every reference to it
# -- a call, a handle's type, a C struct's type -- is written with the name
# the import has in that file, not with the qualifier its #[go.native] mark
# spells. gtk4 runs headless; win32 runs under Wine.

exec sh -c 'root="${SNGL_HOST_GO_MOD%/go.mod}"; sed "s|^module .*|module example.com/app|" "$root/go.mod" > go.mod; printf "\nreplace duckfam.us/sngl => %s\n" "$root" >> go.mod; cp "$root/go.sum" go.sum'
env SNGL_HOST_GO_MOD=$WORK/go.mod

sngl tool cgogen mathx
exists mathx/cgo/wrappers.go

sngl generate --lang go --platform gtk4 -o out app.sngl
grep '^\s+cgo2 "example.com/app/mathx/cgo"$' out/main.go
grep 'cgo2\.PairSum\(' out/main.go
grep 'held__inst0 +cgo2\.Box$' out/main.go
! grep 'cgo\.Pair' out/main.go

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go --opt arch=386 app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

-- mathx/pair.h --
typedef struct pair_t {
	int lo;
	int hi;
} pair_t;

typedef struct pair_box pair_box;

// A pair of lo and hi, its sum, and a box holding n.
pair_t pair_make(int lo, int hi);
int pair_sum(pair_t p);
pair_box *pair_box_new(int n);
int pair_box_n(pair_box *b);
-- mathx/pair.c --
#include <stdlib.h>

#include "pair.h"

struct pair_box {
	int n;
};

pair_t pair_make(int lo, int hi) {
	pair_t p = {lo, hi};
	return p;
}

int pair_sum(pair_t p) {
	return p.lo + p.hi;
}

pair_box *pair_box_new(int n) {
	pair_box *b = malloc(sizeof *b);
	b->n = n;
	return b;
}

int pair_box_n(pair_box *b) {
	return b->n;
}
-- mathx/mathx.sngl --
import c "sngl:x/c"

c.link(include="pair.h", sources=["pair.c", "pair.h"])

#[c.native("pair_t")]
struct Pair {
    lo int
    hi int
}

#[c.native("pair_box *")]
struct Box {}

#[c.native("pair_make")]
func make(lo int, hi int) Pair

#[c.native("pair_sum")]
func sum(p Pair) int

#[c.native("pair_box_new")]
func box(n int) Box

#[c.native("pair_box_n")]
func boxed(b Box) int
-- mathx/gen.go --
package mathx

//go:generate sngl tool cgogen .
-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"
import m "./mathx"

component main ui.node {
    var held m.Box = m.box(7)
    var p m.Pair = m.make(3, 4)
    var said = "{m.sum(p)} {m.boxed(held)}"
    ui.text(said)
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    main()
}

func testItSums(t test.Test) {
    var p = m.make(1, 2)
    t.assert(m.sum(p) == 3)
}

func testItShows(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.said == "7 7")
}
